title: Ultimate Setter Preseason Plan
subtitle: VLY Div 2 · Match 2026-10-11 · Flyefit Mon/Thu/Fri

taperPhases.adjustments: Gym max 3 sets; Sat jumps 3x3; cardio 8 min easy
Legs 2 sets; block jumps 2x3; Sat 2x3 jumps + light ball
Optional 20 min pull+core or full rest
No gym; prehab + 15 easy wall sets

trackingWeekly: Approach jump touch cm on wall
Knee pain 0-10 day after leg days

days.title: Flyefit · Leg A + push

exercises.name: Chest press
exercises.notes: Push; neutral grip if shoulder tight

exercises.name: Shoulder press or landmine + triceps → block jumps
exercises.notes: Push; max height jumps, 90 sec rest between jump sets

exercises.name: Cable crunch or plate hold + bike intervals
